summary.goal: Enable navigation to and from sub-plans when steps have sub_plan_id
summary.context: Steps can reference other plans via sub_plan_id for nested complexity. Users need to drill down into sub-plans and navigate back. This supports the hierarchical plan structure described in docs/planner-scale.md.

acceptance_criteria.description: Steps with sub_plan_id show a 'sub-plan' indicator badge
Clicking a sub-plan step navigates to that plan's detail page
Breadcrumb shows navigation path (Parent Plan > Current Plan)
'Back to Parent' link visible when viewing a sub-plan
Sub-plan steps display child plan's goal as description

display child plan goal as description

views.name: Back to Parent Link
